units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:6">Maasr. I, 6</cite> <he>הבצלים משיְפַקֵּל ואם אינו מְפַקֵּל וכ׳</he> (Y. ed. <he>משיְפַקֵּילוּ</he>; Ms. M. <he>משיקפלו מקפל …</he>) onions are subject to tithes when one begins to strip them (for storage), and if one does not want to strip &c., v. <cite ref="P01362"><he>עֲרֵימָה</he></cite>; Y. ib. 49ᵃ bot. <he>משיְפַקְּלוּ</he>, expl. <he>מן דו ירים וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00333"><he>פּוּרְגָּרָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 2:5">Ukts. II, 5</cite> <he>התחיל … לְפַקֵּל בבצלים</he> when one has begun the stripping &c.; (Tosef. ib. II, 13 <he>לקלף</he>).
